```{r include = FALSE}

#Loading and mutating data

eu_data <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RSHansen02/MappingEUHistory/refs/heads/main/data/eu_data.csv")

eu_data <- eu_data %>%
  mutate(
    group = as.character(year),
    ref_result_yes = as.numeric(ref_result_yes),
    ref_result_no = as.numeric(ref_result_no),
    yes_percentage = round(ref_result_yes / total_votes * 100, 2),
    no_percentage = round(ref_result_no / total_votes * 100, 2)
  )

year_info <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RSHansen02/MappingEUHistory/refs/heads/main/data/aarstal_beskrivelser.csv")

```



```{r include = FALSE}

#Create function to print the plots

create_referendum_plot <- function(country, yes_percentage, no_percentage) {
  ref_results <- data.frame(
    Option = factor(c("Yes", "No"), levels = c("Yes", "No")),
    Percentage = as.numeric(c(yes_percentage, no_percentage))
  )
  
ref_results$Label <- paste0(round(ref_results$Percentage, 1), "%")

plot <- ggplot(ref_results, aes(x = Option, y = Percentage, fill = Option)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "green", "No" = "red")) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
      labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1, accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Referendum Results for", country),
      x = "Option", y = "Percentage"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4, color = "black")
  
  ggsave(
    paste0("graphics/", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", tolower(country)), "_referendum.png"),
    plot,
    width = 4, height = 3, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
}

```



```{r include = FALSE}

#Call on 'create_referendum_plot' to print the plots for all countries with referendums

eu_data %>%
  filter(accession_type == "Referendum") %>%
  distinct(country, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  pmap(~ create_referendum_plot(..2, ..11, ..12))


```



```{r include = FALSE}

#Load ISO3 codes and setup function to read geo data

iso3_codes <- unique(eu_data$country_iso)

read_country_polygon <- function(iso3) {
  url <- paste0(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RSHansen02/MappingEUHistory/main/geo_data/gadm41_",
    iso3, "_0.json"
  )
  message("Trying ", iso3, ": ", url)
  
  tryCatch({
    poly <- st_read(url, quiet = TRUE)
    poly$country_iso <- iso3
    poly
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("❌ Failed: ", iso3)
    NULL
  })
}
```



```{r include = FALSE}

#Read geo data and leftjoin to dataset, create new df "eu_polygons"

all_polygons <- iso3_codes %>%
  map(read_country_polygon) %>%
  compact() %>%   # remove NULLs from failed reads
  bind_rows()

# Simplify polygons for better performance (optional)
eu_polygons_simple <- ms_simplify(all_polygons, keep = 0.05, keep_shapes = TRUE)

# Join with eu_data to get accession year and info for each country polygon
# This assumes eu_data has 'country_iso', 'year', 'accession_type', 'country' columns
eu_polygons <- eu_polygons_simple %>%
  left_join(
    eu_data %>% 
      distinct(country_iso, country, year, accession_type), 
    by = "country_iso"
  )

```

```{r echo = FALSE}

# Define and run server

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  polygons_initialized <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  
  output$eu_map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet(options = leafletOptions(
      dragging = TRUE,
      zoomControl = FALSE,
      scrollWheelZoom = FALSE,
      doubleClickZoom = FALSE,
      preferCanvas = TRUE,
      touchZoom = FALSE,
      maxBounds = list(
      list(lat = 25, lng = -25),  
      list(lat = 80, lng = 45)    
    )
    )) %>%
      addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") %>%
      fitBounds(
      lng1 = -10.5, lat1 = 33,   # SW corner (lng, lat)
      lng2 = 33.5, lat2 = 71     # NE corner (lng, lat)
    )
  })
  
  observe({
    if (!polygons_initialized()) {
      for (yr in sort(unique(eu_data$year))) {
        layer_sf <- eu_polygons %>% filter(year == yr)
        if (nrow(layer_sf) == 0) next
        
        leafletProxy("eu_map") %>%
          addPolygons(
            data = layer_sf,
            group = as.character(yr),
            stroke = TRUE,
            color = "white",
            weight = 1,
            fillColor = "darkblue",
            fillOpacity = 0.8,
            popup = ~paste0(
              "<b>", country, "</b><br>",
              "Year: ", year, "<br>",
              "Accession Type: ", accession_type, "<br>",
              ifelse(
                accession_type == "Referendum",
                paste0(
                  "<img src='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RSHansen02/MappingEUHistory/main/graphics/",
                  gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", tolower(country)), "_referendum.png' width='200'>"
                ), ""
              )
            ),
            options = popupOptions(
              autoPan = FALSE),
            highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
              weight = 3,
              color = "yellow",
              fillOpacity = 1,
              bringToFront = TRUE
            )
          )
      }
      polygons_initialized(TRUE)
    }
  })
  
  observe({
    selected_year <- as.numeric(input$year_choice)
    all_years <- sort(unique(eu_data$year))
    
    proxy <- leafletProxy("eu_map")
    for (yr in all_years) {
      proxy <- hideGroup(proxy, group = as.character(yr))
    }
    for (yr in all_years[all_years <= selected_year]) {
      proxy <- showGroup(proxy, group = as.character(yr))
    }
  })
  
  output$year_info_box <- renderUI({
    selected_year <- as.numeric(input$year_choice)
    info_row <- year_info %>% filter(year == selected_year)
    
    if (nrow(info_row) == 1) {
      div(
        style = "border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 10px; background-color: #f9f9f9; border-radius: 6px;",
        HTML(paste0("<b>", selected_year, " Expansion:</b><br>", info_row$description))
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

```
